findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant scoping when loading documents
findings.body: When a caller supplies an ID belonging to another tenant, `getDocument` now drops `ctx.tenantId` and `loadDocument` queries only by `documentId`. This removes the tenant predicate that previously enforced isolation, so a shared database can return another tenant's document. Keep the authenticated tenant ID in the lookup.

findings.title: [P2] Preserve the exported cache reader contract
findings.body: Deleting `src/cache.ts` removes the exported `readCached` API outright. Consumers of this module will fail module resolution or compilation after upgrading; retain the export or provide a compatible replacement/migration as part of this contract-preserving change.
